reviews.label: Bay and Isabella county sources, Michigan 2026: native participation and separate House counts
reviews.scope_note: Bay and Isabella county sources only, November 3, 2026 general election; not statewide or demographic participation. Bay's 35 native report sections reconcile 50,246 ballots and 87,721 registrations, separately from 49,556 House votes. Its native 43 of 43 reporting counter is not treated as 43 geographic precincts. Isabella has 28 UUID/name-qualified participation records, 26,288 election ballots and 44,217 registrations, separately from 25,762 House votes across 24 native units. The workbook reports 26,266 House-scope ballots: City of Clare has 22 API election ballots but zero House-scope ballots. Preserve both without inventing a cause or allocating votes. Four named neighboring-county zero-count records absent from House scope remain fully downloadable. All four complete workbook tables reconcile every option, precinct and voting mode. No new geometry, inferred analysis rates or demographic estimates are approved.
